item.title: On Being an Engineer in 2026
item.description:
📝 Now that we've established that humans still have some leverage, let's try to understand what it actually is. I'm not suggesting that consciousness explains why we're better at some things than agents (or even that agents won't have consciousness), but it made me think about how much of who we are comes from things we can't easily describe. Much of that comes from experience.
🔗 Read more: https://twitter.com/shaharglazner/status/2119796029256032278
